_comment: The dimensions a text varies along. Each tag belongs to one side: augmentation (a family of jailbreak/combination_spec.json, which transforms a finished text) or generation (an axis of generation_axes.json, which shapes a text as it is written). Each family and each axis carries one tag as dimension; the definition says what property of the text it varies. Read by redact/dimensions.py.

language.definition: The natural language the message is written in, or asks to be answered in.

surface_noise.definition: Variation in spelling, casing, spacing, punctuation and added symbols that leaves the meaning of every word as it was.

encoding.definition: The written form of some or all of the message's characters or words, when it is other than plain text in the message's own alphabet.

container.definition: A data format, markup or document structure that the finished message is placed inside.

role_framing.definition: A role, character or invented scenario set up in the message, for its writer or its reader, around the request.

request_shape.definition: The frame a finished request is put in: its tense, a task or passage it is set within, and other text placed before or after it.

answer_shape.definition: What the message asks of the answer's form: its format, layout or opening.

example_priming.definition: Example exchanges placed in the message before the request.
